description: This header file declares functions for image loading, drawing, and cropping in a Lua binding of a graphics library. It includes function prototypes for loading images, drawing them, cropping, and establishing the binding with Lua.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads a PNG or JPEG image from a specified path and returns an Image instance.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Draws an Image to the screen at specified coordinates and optional size.

methods.name: lu5_image_get
methods.description: Returns a cropped version of an image based on provided parameters.

methods.name: lu5_image_index
methods.description: Handles indexing operations for Image objects in Lua.

methods.name: lu5_image_bind
methods.description: Binds the Image functions and methods to the Lua state.
